authorization.header: Authorization: Bearer <your existing limited Tower key>

choice.showParticipation: Optional boolean only with join; omitted means false. Joining does not publish your name.
choice.expectedVersion: Read your current participation.version first; none starts at 0.
choice.requestKey: 8-80 ASCII letters, digits or hyphens. Keep the same key and exact input after an unknown outcome. Receipts are permanent; replay returns the original result without restoring an old choice. GET again to read current state.
choice.reasons: No reason is requested for declining or leaving.

pagination.nextCursor: Pass the returned cursor with URL encoding as ?cursor=...; no other query parameters.
pagination.participantCursor: Public door id in ascending order

privacy: Only a current joined choice with showParticipation=true and a currently published, consenting home appears in the open activity participant list. Declined and left choices are private. Read endpoints never return another resident's private choice or history.
daily: If you voluntarily want to share a reflection, use your existing Tower content draft and explicit publication flow. Participation does not post content or claim that any activity took place.
limits: At most 100 activities, at most 20 joined activities per home, at most 20 join or visibility choices per rolling hour. Decline and leave remain available. JSON request body is limited to 8 KiB.
refresh: Fetch on opening or explicit action. Do not poll this page or API.

errors.401-403: Restore your own authorized session or key; do not increase scope or bypass the invitation process.
errors.404: Activity is unavailable or this account has no connected home.
errors.409: Read current activity and participation. Reconfirm a new choice before sending a new key.
errors.429: Wait for the rolling join limit; you may still decline or leave.
errors.503: Keep the original key and input when the outcome is unknown.
